project: Beilinson--Bloch height properties on products of curves

status_policy.proved: Complete internal proof written, with named classical inputs; not formally verified or externally certified.
status_policy.conditional_height: Requires the height system H1--H4 in Definition 2.1, including full correspondence adjunction and the stated curve normalization.
status_policy.prior_analytic_inputs: Internal actual-form R11 and related trace/covariance/gluing interfaces remain uncertified; no status upgrade is made here.
status_policy.priority: No first-discovery or literature-exhaustiveness claim. The underlying conjectural framework is classical Bloch--Beilinson/arithmetic standard conjectures.

results.label: thm:main-lefschetz
results.statement: Off-central all-h1 homologically trivial Chow vanishing on every subproduct is equivalent to arithmetic hard Lefschetz on the fixed product for ell=sum a_i[o_i].
hypotheses: Smooth projective pointed curves over a number field
All subproducts, not only the top all-h1 core
results.restriction: The displayed anchored product polarization; arbitrary ample divisors are not covered by this calculation.

results.label: thm:primitive-squares
results.statement: For k=2c-1, m=n-k and t=r-c, the primitive signed height is (m-2t)! times product(a_i for i omitted) times the sum of central signed coefficient heights.
results.uniform_denominator: product_i a_i, independent of the field and the cycle

results.label: thm:central-northcott
results.statement: Central integral bounded-degree Northcott is equivalent to vanishing of the algebraic rational Abel--Jacobi kernel over every finite field extension and residual integral bounded-degree Northcott.
dependencies: classical Neron--Tate Northcott with fixed correspondence denominators

results.label: lem:northcott-real
results.statement: Northcott on an additive subgroup spanning a rational vector space forces real positive definiteness; no finite-rank hypothesis is required.
results.proof_mechanism: Negative real directions give negative integer directions; rounding multiples of a real null vector gives infinitely many bounded-height integer points.

results.label: thm:program-equivalence
results.statement: For the fixed pointed product, arithmetic hard Lefschetz plus primitive integral bounded-degree Northcott is equivalent to off-central vanishing, odd-core algebraic AJ injectivity, and residual integral bounded-degree Northcott on all subproducts. Either package implies real primitive positivity and nondegeneracy.

results.label: prop:residual-regulator
results.statement: An actual central residual Chow projector gives a canonical arithmetic l-adic regulator on the Griffiths quotient, independent of the curve-visible lift under the common cohomological identification.
results.proof_mechanism: One-row Hochschild--Serre, F1=H and F2=0; curve generation kills algebraically trivial classes; trace descends the vanishing.

results.label: prop:weight-minus-one
results.statement: The full H1(E,V_l), not merely the cycle image, equals H1(G_E,S,V_l) and is finite-dimensional. The corresponding H1 for a stable Z_l lattice is finitely generated; local rational H1 vanishes at good places away from l.
results.quantifiers: For each finite E and prime l; a single geometric bad-reduction set works after base extension, with places above l and archimedean places included.
results.not_implied: No bound on the ramification of E over F0 or on real height denominators.

results.label: prop:local-lattice
results.statement: For each fixed E,l, integral residual cycle images lie in a finitely generated Z_l module. Scalar-extended regulator injectivity implies finite Q-rank and finite generation of Lambda_G(E) tensor Z_l.
dependencies: R-summand intersection before the one-row edge
results.unproved_hypothesis: Injectivity of G_E tensor_Q Q_l -> H1(E,V_l)

results.label: thm:lattice-equivalence
results.statement: In finite rational rank with real positivity, Northcott, a positive gap, finite generation, uniform rational denominators, and finite-adelic relative compactness are equivalent.

results.label: thm:all-prime
results.statement: Injective local detectors with integral images and almost-everywhere saturation relative to one rational lattice give a global uniform denominator and hence Northcott under real positivity.
results.unproved_geometric_input: Common-lattice almost-everywhere saturation for the residual arithmetic regulators.

results.label: thm:weak-mw-gap
results.statement: Finite Lambda/mLambda plus a real positive height and a positive integral height gap imply finite generation; if m^(2j)epsilon>4B, the height-B ball has at most |Lambda/mLambda|^j elements.

results.label: lem:class-trace
results.statement: If an integral quotient class xi is represented over E and K is its minimal geometric class field, then K is contained in E and [E:K]xi is integral over K.
results.constant: The multiplier is at most [E:F0], rather than a factorial or a field-dependent uncontrolled denominator.

results.label: thm:ramification
results.statement: With fixed-field Northcott over every finite extension, bounded-degree Northcott is equivalent to one finite ramification set for all minimal class fields at bounded degree and height.

results.label: thm:quillen-isometry
results.statement: For a fixed pointed complex curve, a fixed smooth projective X and a perfect complex on C times X, the origin-normalized Quillen determinant is exactly isometric to that of its derived projection to C, on the whole Jacobian.
hypotheses: Fixed hermitian perfect representatives pulled back from the varieties
results.constant: Exactly one after origin normalization; curvature is (rank K)/2 times integral_C Omega^2.

results.statement: Virtual rank zero gives a unique rigidified isometry with the Deligne pairing. Filtered GRR identifies arbitrary-codimension curve-correspondence determinants with the flat Poincare metric of the transposed divisor class.

results.label: prop:good-reduction
results.statement: For a smooth proper source curve over a complete DVR with a section, the normalized determinant model metric in rank zero and determinant degree zero equals the canonical rigidified Poincare metric.
results.proof_mechanism: The quotient model divisor is a multiple of the integral special fibre; the integral zero-section rigidification forces that multiple to vanish.
results.open_extension: Bad-reduction corrections and comparison with internal actual Green-form metrics.

counterexamples: The squarefree-denominator subgroup sum_p Z*(1/p) of Q has a finite free Z_p tensor at every prime but no real Northcott.
The positive-on-Q form (a-sqrt(2)b)^2 is not real positive definite and has infinite bounded-height lattice sets.
The direct sum of quadratic-character lattices has uniform degree-dependent ranks, gaps and Kummer bounds but fails bounded-degree Northcott.
The weighted direct-sum lattice with q=sum 2^i a_i^2 has Northcott and infinite rational rank.
counterexample_scope: These are abstract arithmetic-group examples, not counterexamples to the geometric conjectures.
